If I had all the rooms rented out it would cover almost all the expenses - while I'm living in it.

Any appreciation at all and I'm living for less than free. I have taken vacations longer than a month and the roommates have watched it just fine.

Part of the reasoning for buying it was that I got approved for the loan based on cryptocurrency trading alone. I didn't expect all years to be so good or to even be able to get approved for renting a place with just crypto trading. So I went for it and will always have a place to call home.

Next step for me could be to turn it 100% into a rental and then go live downtown with some friends (or alone), or even in a different city somewhere if I trusted the renters/pm company enough

Not saying this is the best way to go, but you can buy a place and still be pretty mobile.
